scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:python && pnpm run setup:env && pnpm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:frontend: pnpm --dir frontend install && pnpm --dir frontend run build
scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('.env')) { console.log('.env already exists'); process.exit(0); } fs.writeFileSync('.env', 'GEMINI_API_KEY=\nFRONTEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/app\n'); console.log('Created .env — add your GEMINI_API_KEY');"
